question:
The bar graph given below shows the number of pens sold by five given shops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57b78246983c986ffede08aa6fe7830f292026263db717a954addad066cc3e32.png] 

Which shop has sold maximum number of pens?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Shop Name
 Number of Pens Sold
 
 

 A
 50
 
 

 B
 40
 
 

 C
 30
 
 

 D
 90
 
 

 E
 60
 
 

**Formula Used:**

Maximum value = The highest value among the given data set.

**Calculation:**

According to the bar graph, the number of pens sold by each shop is as follows:

⇒ Pens sold by Shop A = 50

⇒ Pens sold by Shop B = 40

⇒ Pens sold by Shop C = 30

⇒ Pens sold by Shop D = 90

⇒ Pens sold by Shop E = 60

On comparing the number of pens sold by all shops:

⇒ 90 > 60 > 50 > 40 > 30

⇒ The maximum number of pens sold is 90.

⇒ The shop corresponding to 90 pens sold is Shop D.

**∴ The correct answer is D.**
